business_problem: Fonterra needed a stronger CMDB and more reliable service processes so it could reduce incident noise, accelerate problem management, and build resilient digital operations.
solution_summary: Fonterra needed a stronger CMDB and more reliable service processes so it could reduce incident noise, accelerate problem management, and build resilient digital operations. Fonterra implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, IT Service Management, CMDB, and Predictive Intelligence. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; CMDB stores service and asset context; Predictive Intelligence classifies and routes work. The stack also connected Knowledge Base so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs. Requests enter through Employee Center, are classified or summarized by Predictive Intelligence, and uses context from CMDB and Knowledge Base before ServiceNow AI Platform and IT Service Management routes or fulfills the work.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Standardizes incident, request, and fulfillment workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: CMDB
solution_components.role: Maintains service and asset context that automation and support teams rely on.

solution_components.name: Predictive Intelligence
solution_components.role: Classifies, routes, and prioritizes work using machine-learning models.

solution_components.name: Employee Center
solution_components.role: Serves a single portal for requests, knowledge, and support interactions.

data_flow: Requests enter through Employee Center, are classified or summarized by Predictive Intelligence, and uses context from CMDB and Knowledge Base before ServiceNow AI Platform and IT Service Management routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform.
business_outcome: Fonterra improved MTTR for high-priority incidents by 92%, cut event incident tickets by 90%, and used better service context to speed fulfillment and resilience work.
